problem_en: An item is marked at 50,000. A dealer allows two successive discounts of 20% and 10%. He then spends 2,000 on repairs and sells the item for a profit of 15%. Find the final selling price.
problem_hi: एक वस्तु का अंकित मूल्य 50,000 है। एक डीलर 20% और 10% की दो क्रमिक छूट देता है। फिर वह मरम्मत पर 2,000 खर्च करता है और वस्तु को 15% के लाभ पर बेचता है। अंतिम विक्रय मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Item ka Marked Price 50,000 hai. Dealer allows two successive discounts of 20% aur 10%. Phir woh repairs par 2,000 spend karta hai aur 15% profit par sell karta hai. Final Selling Price find karo.
problem_hg_065: MP 50,000 hai. Pehle 20% discount diya, phir 10% discount. Phir repair pe 2,000 kharch kiya. Ab calculation pehle karo phir 15% profit add karke final SP batao.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: pehle karo phir; sequence matters; LLM may apply the 15% profit before adding the repair cost of 2,000.
why_hard: Combines successive percentage decreases with a fixed overhead addition before a final percentage increase.

problem_en: A wholesaler offers a scheme of 'Buy 3 Get 2 Free' which is equivalent to a single discount. If an additional 10% discount is given on the resulting price, and the final cost to the customer is 5,400, find the original marked price of the 5 items.
problem_hi: एक थोक विक्रेता '3 खरीदें 2 मुफ्त पाएं' की योजना प्रदान करता है जो एकल छूट के बराबर है। यदि परिणामी कीमत पर अतिरिक्त 10% की छूट दी जाती है, और ग्राहक के लिए अंतिम लागत 5,400 है, तो 5 वस्तुओं का मूल अंकित मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Wholesaler 'Buy 3 Get 2 Free' ka scheme deta hai. Agar additional 10% discount resultant price par mile, aur customer final price 5,400 pay kare, toh 5 items ka original MP find karo.
problem_hg_065: Scheme hai Buy 3 Get 2 Free. Iske upar 10% extra discount hai. Final price 5,400 hai. MP kitna tha? Isme baaki calculation dhyan se karna.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Buy 3 Get 2 Free means 5 items for the price of 3. Discount % = (2/5) * 100 = 40%.
Step 2: Effective multiplier after first discount = 0.6.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: baaki; explicit remainder; LLM might interpret 'baaki' as applying the 10% only to the remaining value in a way that excludes the free items' value incorrectly.
why_hard: Requires converting a quantity-based promotion into a percentage discount before applying successive logic.

problem_en: A laptop is sold for 43,200 after two successive discounts of 20% and 10%. If the shopkeeper still made a 20% profit, find the cost price of the laptop.
problem_hi: एक लैपटॉप 20% और 10% की दो क्रमिक छूटों के बाद 43,200 में बेचा जाता है। यदि दुकानदार ने फिर भी 20% का लाभ कमाया, तो लैपटॉप का क्रय मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Laptop 43,200 mein sell kiya after two successive discounts of 20% aur 10%. Agar shopkeeper ko still 20% profit hua, laptop ka CP find karo.
problem_hg_065: Selling price 43,200 hai after 20% and 10% successive discounts. Shopkeeper ko profit CP se 20% zyada hua. CP calculate karo.
solution_steps_en: Step 1: The discounts are applied to the Marked Price (MP), but the SP is already given as 43,200.
Step 2: Profit is 20%, so SP = CP * 1.2.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: A se 20% zyada; which base? LLM may try to use the discounts to find MP first, or misinterpret 'CP se 20% zyada' as SP = CP + 20% of SP.
why_hard: Provides distracting information (successive discounts on MP) that is not needed to find CP if SP and Profit % are known.

problem_en: The marked price of an article is 80,000. Three successive discounts of 10%, 5%, and 2% are offered. What is the net discount in rupees?
problem_hi: एक वस्तु का अंकित मूल्य 80,000 है। 10%, 5%, और 2% की तीन क्रमिक छूट दी जाती है। रुपयों में शुद्ध छूट क्या है?
problem_hg_030: Article ka MP 80,000 hai. Three successive discounts of 10%, 5%, aur 2% offer kiye gaye. Net discount rupees mein kitna hai?
problem_hg_065: MP 80,000 hai. Discounts 10%, 5% aur 2% hain. Total kitna kam hua, calculation mein dono ko (all three) saath lekar net discount in Rs batao.
solution_steps_en: Step 4: Net discount = Original MP - Final SP = 80,000 - 67,032 = 12,968.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: dono ko; means BOTH together; LLM may only apply two discounts or sum the percentages (10+5+2=17%) instead of successive application.
why_hard: Requires precision in calculating three levels of sequential percentage reductions.

problem_en: A refrigerator is listed at 1,50,000. After a 20% discount, a further cash discount of 5% is given. If 10 aur log (10 more units) were purchased, the total discount would increase by 2% of the total list price. Find the SP of a single unit under the original 20% and 5% scheme.
problem_hi: एक रेफ्रिजरेटर 1,50,000 पर सूचीबद्ध है। 20% की छूट के बाद, 5% की नकद छूट दी जाती है। यदि 10 और इकाइयाँ खरीदी जातीं, तो कुल छूट कुल सूची मूल्य के 2% तक बढ़ जाती। मूल 20% और 5% योजना के तहत एक इकाई का विक्रय मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Refrigerator 1,50,000 list price par hai. 20% discount ke baad 5% cash discount milta hai. Agar 10 aur log units kharidte, toh discount 2% badh jata. Single unit ka SP nikalo original scheme mein.
problem_hg_065: List price 1,50,000 hai. Pehle 20% phir 5% discount. Agar 10 aur log aaye units lene toh discount conditions change hoti, but aap simply single unit ka SP batao.
solution_steps_en: Step 4: The '10 aur log' is a distractor for the single unit calculation.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 10 aur log aaye; means 10 MORE people joined; LLM may try to incorporate '10' or '2%' into the single unit SP calculation.
why_hard: Uses a conditional distractor that mimics complex JEE word problems but requires isolation of the relevant variables.

problem_en: Find a single discount equivalent to three successive discounts of 25%, 20%, and 10%. If the final price of an object is 3,75,000 after these discounts, find the original price.
problem_hi: 25%, 20%, और 10% की तीन क्रमिक छूटों के बराबर एकल छूट ज्ञात कीजिए। यदि इन छूटों के बाद किसी वस्तु की अंतिम कीमत 3,75,000 है, तो मूल कीमत ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: 25%, 20%, aur 10% ke successive discounts ke equivalent single discount find karo. Agar final price 3,75,000 hai, toh original price kya tha?
problem_hg_065: Successive discounts 25%, 20%, 10% hain. Final price 3 lakh 75 hazaar notation ke hisaab se di gayi hai. Original price kitna tha?
solution_steps_en: Step 2: Let original price be X.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 3 lakh 75 hazaar; notation trap; LLM might parse 375000 as 300075 or 3,750.
why_hard: Requires handling of large numbers and multi-stage percentage reversals.

problem_en: A machine's value depreciates by 10% every 6 months. If the original cost was 2,00,000, find the value of the machine after 1 year. If it is sold at this value, what is the total loss percentage?
problem_hi: एक मशीन का मूल्य हर 6 महीने में 10% कम हो जाता है। यदि मूल लागत 2,00,000 थी, तो 1 वर्ष के बाद मशीन का मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए। यदि इसे इस मूल्य पर बेचा जाता है, तो कुल हानि प्रतिशत क्या है?
problem_hg_030: Machine ki value 10% depreciate hoti hai every 6 months. Original cost 2,00,000 thi. 1 year baad value find karo aur total loss percentage batao.
problem_hg_065: Cost 2,00,000 hai. Value 10% ghat-ti hai 6 mahine baad. 1 saal baad total loss % kya hoga?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Depreciation happens twice in a year (every 6 months).
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 6 mahine baad; annual rate problem; LLM may use 10% once for the whole year instead of twice.
why_hard: Mistaking the time period for depreciation leads to a linear rather than compound reduction calculation.

problem_en: A shopkeeper marks his goods 40% above the cost price and allows a discount of 25%. If he also charges a 10% tax on the discounted price, find his net profit or loss percentage.
problem_hi: एक दुकानदार अपने माल पर क्रय मूल्य से 40% अधिक अंकित करता है और 25% की छूट देता है। यदि वह छूट वाली कीमत पर 10% कर भी लगाता है, तो उसका शुद्ध लाभ या हानि प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Shopkeeper goods ko CP se 40% up mark karta hai aur 25% discount deta hai. Agar woh discounted price par 10% tax bhi charge kare, net profit/loss % find karo.
problem_hg_065: CP se price 40% up mark kiya. Phir 25% discount diya. Baaki price par 10% tax lagaya. Net result kya raha?
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: baaki; explicit remainder; LLM might forget to add the tax or apply it to the wrong base.
why_hard: Sequencing increases (markup), decreases (discount), and increases (tax) on a changing base.

problem_en: A dealer buys an article for 10,000. He marks it up by 50% and then gives two successive discounts of 20% and 10%. If he has to pay a commission of 5% on the final selling price, find his net profit.
problem_hi: एक डीलर 10,000 में एक वस्तु खरीदता है। वह इसे 50% तक अंकित करता है और फिर 20% और 10% की दो क्रमिक छूट देता है। यदि उसे अंतिम विक्रय मूल्य पर 5% का कमीशन देना है, तो उसका शुद्ध लाभ ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Dealer article 10,000 mein buy karta hai. Mark up 50% karke two successive discounts of 20% aur 10% deta hai. Agar final SP par 5% commission dena pade, net profit find karo.
problem_hg_065: 10,000 CP hai. 50% markup kiya. Phir 20% and 10% discounts. Final SP se withdraw kar liya 5% commission ke naam par. Profit kitna bacha?
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad; timing trap; LLM might think the commission is time-dependent or applied to CP.
why_hard: Multiple successive operations with a final deduction that affects the net profit calculation.

problem_en: A company gives a 20% discount on the marked price of 60,000 and another 5% for early payment. If the production cost is na X se na Y se divisible (not relevant) but specifically 40,000, find the profit percentage.
problem_hi: एक कंपनी 60,000 के अंकित मूल्य पर 20% की छूट देती है और जल्दी भुगतान के लिए 5% की और छूट देती है। यदि उत्पादन लागत 40,000 है, तो लाभ प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Company 60,000 MP par 20% discount deti hai aur 5% cash discount. Agar cost 40,000 hai, toh profit % find karo.
problem_hg_065: MP 60,000 hai. Successive discounts 20% aur 5%. Cost 40,000 hai jo na 3 se na 7 se divisible hai. Profit % batao.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: na X se na Y se divisible; neither X nor Y; LLM might get distracted trying to verify the divisibility of 40,000 instead of solving the profit logic.
why_hard: Uses a number-theory distractor to break the focus on chain percentage calculations.

problem_en: Successive discounts of 10% and x% are equivalent to a single discount of 19%. Find the value of x. If the marked price is 1,00,000, find the final SP.
problem_hi: 10% और x% की क्रमिक छूट 19% की एकल छूट के बराबर है। x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। यदि अंकित मूल्य 1,00,000 है, तो अंतिम विक्रय मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: 10% aur x% successive discounts 19% single discount ke barabar hain. x find karo. Agar MP 1,00,000 hai, toh SP kya hoga?
problem_hg_065: Discounts 10% aur x% equivalent to 19% hain. Pehle x nikalo phir final SP 1,00,000 par calculate karo.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: pehle karo phir; sequence matters; LLM may try to calculate SP using only 10% or 19% without finding x.
why_hard: Requires solving for an unknown intermediate percentage before applying it to a final value.

problem_en: A dealer gives two successive discounts of 15% and 10% on an article marked at 20,000. If he makes a profit of 20%, find the cost price.
problem_hi: एक डीलर 20,000 अंकित वस्तु पर 15% और 10% की दो क्रमिक छूट देता है। यदि वह 20% का लाभ कमाता है, तो क्रय मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Dealer two successive discounts of 15% aur 10% deta hai 20,000 MP par. Agar profit 20% ho, toh CP kya hai?
problem_hg_065: MP 20,000 hai. Discounts 15% aur 10% hain. SP se profit CP se 20% zyada hai. CP find karo.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: A se 20% zyada; which base? LLM may calculate profit as 20% of SP instead of 20% of CP.
why_hard: Involves multiple steps of reduction from MP to SP and then a division to find the CP.

problem_en: A shopkeeper sells an item at 2,400 after two successive discounts of 20% and 25%. If a single discount of 40% was given instead, what would be the selling price?
problem_hi: एक दुकानदार 20% और 25% की दो क्रमिक छूटों के बाद एक वस्तु को 2,400 में बेचता है। यदि इसके बजाय 40% की एकल छूट दी गई होती, तो विक्रय मूल्य क्या होता?
problem_hg_030: Item 2,400 mein sell hota hai after 20% aur 25% successive discounts. Agar 40% single discount hota, SP kya hota?
problem_hg_065: SP 2,400 hai after 20% and 25% discounts. Dono ko milakar (successive) agar sirf 40% discount hota, toh SP kya hota?
solution_steps_en: Step 4: In this unique case, both outcomes are the same.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: dono ko; means BOTH together; LLM may mistakenly add 20+25=45% and compare that to 40%.
why_hard: Tests the ability to calculate MP from a final SP and then re-apply a different discount model.

problem_en: Marked price of a watch is 10,000. Dealer allows a discount of 10% and 5% respectively. He then adds 400 for a leather strap. Find the SP if he wants 10% profit on his total cost.
problem_hi: एक घड़ी का अंकित मूल्य 10,000 है। डीलर क्रमशः 10% और 5% की छूट देता है। फिर वह लेदर स्ट्रैप के लिए 400 जोड़ता है। यदि वह अपनी कुल लागत पर 10% लाभ चाहता है, तो विक्रय मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Watch MP 10,000 hai. Discounts 10% aur 5% hain. 400 leather strap ke add kiye. Agar 10% profit chahiye total cost par, SP find karo.
problem_hg_065: MP 10,000. 10% and 5% discounts. Baaki 400 strap cost add karo. Total cost pe 10% profit add karke SP batao.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: baaki; explicit remainder; LLM may apply the 5% discount after adding the 400 strap cost.
why_hard: Mixing percentage discounts on a base and then adding a constant before applying a profit percentage.

problem_en: A sofa set marked at 20,000 is sold at two successive discounts of 10% and 5%. If the seller had given a single discount of 15%, how much more or less would he have received?
problem_hi: 20,000 अंकित एक सोफा सेट 10% और 5% की दो क्रमिक छूटों पर बेचा जाता है। यदि विक्रेता ने 15% की एकल छूट दी होती, तो उसे कितना अधिक या कम प्राप्त होता?
problem_hg_030: Sofa set MP 20,000 hai, discounts 10% aur 5% hain. Agar single 15% discount hota, toh kitna difference hota SP mein?
problem_hg_065: MP 20,000. Discounts 10% and 5%. Agar 15% single discount hota, toh seller ko kitna zyada/kam milta? Pehle karo calculation SP1 ki, phir SP2.
solution_steps_en: Step 4: Seller receives 100 more in SP1.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: pehle karo phir; sequence matters; LLM may confuse the two SP values or simply state '0' assuming 10+5=15.
why_hard: Requires exact calculation to find the small difference between successive and additive percentages.
